name: Coriander powder
storage: Airtight jar at room temperature, away from light, steam and heat. It lasts about 3–6 months once opened, and the aroma fades with time.
looksLike: a light brown to greenish-khaki powder with a warm, citrusy, slightly sweet smell.
howToPick: fresh powder smells strongly of citrus when you open the pack. It should be greenish-brown and free-flowing. Avoid powder that is dusty-brown, has little smell or is caked. Coriander powder loses its aroma faster than most spices, so smaller packs are better.
shelfLife: about 9–12 months unopened (check the pack). It is best used within 3–4 months of opening.
substitutes: Coriander seeds, dry-roasted and ground fresh, 1
